title: How to Reset VPN Password
content:
To reset your VPN password:
1. Visit the self-service portal at https://selfservice.techcorp.com
2. Click on 'Forgot Password' or 'Reset VPN Credentials'
3. Enter your employee email address and employee ID
4. Check your registered email for a password reset link (valid for 30 minutes)
5. Follow the link and set a new password (min 12 characters, must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character)
6. Reconnect to VPN using Cisco AnyConnect with your new credentials
If you do not receive the reset email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder or contact the IT helpdesk.

title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
content:
Common VPN troubleshooting steps:
1. Ensure you have a stable internet connection
2. Restart the Cisco AnyConnect client
3. Check if VPN server address is: vpn.techcorp.com
4. Ensure your VPN credentials are not expired (passwords expire every 90 days)
5. Temporarily disable firewall/antivirus and retry
6. Clear the AnyConnect cache: Go to Preferences > Clear Cache
7. Reinstall Cisco AnyConnect if the above steps fail
8. Check system status at status.techcorp.com for known outages
If problem persists, raise a support ticket with your error message and employee ID.

title: Laptop Not Turning On - Troubleshooting Guide
content:
If your laptop won't turn on:
1. Ensure the laptop is charged - connect to power adapter for 15 minutes
2. Check if the power LED indicator is lit
3. Perform a hard reset: Hold the power button for 15 seconds, release, then press again
4. Check for physical damage or liquid spills
5. If using a docking station, try without it
6. Remove and re-seat the battery (if removable)
7. Try connecting to external monitor to test display
If none of these steps work, your laptop may need hardware inspection. Please raise a support ticket for hardware assessment.

title: Windows Password Reset Procedure
content:
To reset your Windows/Active Directory password:
Option 1 - Self Service Portal (Recommended):
1. Go to https://selfservice.techcorp.com from any device
2. Click 'Reset Windows Password'
3. Verify identity using your employee ID and registered mobile
4. Set a new password

Option 2 - IT Helpdesk:
1. Call IT Helpdesk at ext. 4357 (HELP)
2. Provide your employee ID and answer security questions
3. Temporary password will be issued
4. You must change this password on first login

Password Requirements: Minimum 12 characters, uppercase + lowercase + number + special character, cannot reuse last 12 passwords.

title: Setting Up Email on Mobile Device
content:
To set up corporate email on your mobile device:
For iOS (iPhone/iPad):
1. Download Microsoft Outlook from App Store
2. Open Outlook and tap Add Account
3. Enter your corporate email: firstname.lastname@techcorp.com
4. Enter your Windows/AD password
5. Accept the MDM enrollment if prompted

For Android:
1. Download Microsoft Outlook from Play Store
2. Follow the same steps as iOS
3. Accept device management policy when prompted

Note: Corporate email setup requires MDM enrollment for security compliance. Contact IT if you receive enrollment errors.

title: Requesting New Software Installation
content:
To request software installation:
1. Raise a software request ticket through IT Support
2. Include: software name, version, business justification, and urgency
3. Manager approval is required for all software requests
4. IT team will assess license availability and security compliance
5. Approved software is typically deployed within 2-3 business days via SCCM
6. Emergency installations can be expedited with manager and IT Director approval

Note: Unauthorized software installation is prohibited per IT Security Policy. All software must be approved and deployed by IT.

title: Connecting to Office Wi-Fi
content:
To connect to office Wi-Fi:
Corporate Network (SSID: TechCorp-Corporate):
1. Select TechCorp-Corporate from Wi-Fi list
2. Enter your Windows username and password
3. Accept the certificate if prompted

Guest Network (SSID: TechCorp-Guest):
1. Select TechCorp-Guest
2. Open browser - you'll be redirected to the captive portal
3. Enter your employee email to receive a one-day access code

Note: Only use TechCorp-Corporate for accessing company resources. Guest network does not allow access to internal systems.

title: Requesting New Hardware / Equipment
content:
To request new hardware:
1. Submit a hardware request ticket with: item description, business justification, urgency level
2. Manager approval required for items over $200
3. Director approval required for items over $1000
4. Standard hardware requests are fulfilled within 5-7 business days
5. Emergency hardware (laptop failure) can be fulfilled within 24-48 hours with proper approvals

Standard Issued Equipment:
- Laptop: Dell Latitude or MacBook Pro (role-dependent)
- Monitor: 24-inch Dell
- Accessories: Keyboard, mouse, webcam included

title: Printer Setup and Troubleshooting
content:
Setting up a printer:
1. Go to Settings > Printers & Scanners
2. Click 'Add a printer or scanner'
3. Select your floor printer from the list (naming convention: FLR{floor}-PRT{number})
4. Driver installs automatically via Active Directory

Printer Troubleshooting:
1. Check if printer is online (green light)
2. Clear the print queue: Settings > Printers > right-click > See what's printing > Cancel All
3. Restart the Print Spooler service (IT can assist)
4. Check paper and toner levels
5. Restart the printer

For persistent issues, raise a ticket with printer name and error message.

title: New Employee Account Setup Checklist
content:
New employee IT onboarding checklist:
1. Windows/AD Account - Created by IT before day 1
2. Email Account - Auto-provisioned with AD account
3. VPN Access - Requires manager approval, setup within day 1
4. Laptop - Pre-configured and delivered on day 1
5. Software Access - Based on role, provisioned within day 1-2
6. Badge Access - Coordinated with facilities team

New employees should attend IT orientation on their first day.
For missing access, contact IT at helpdesk@techcorp.com or ext. 4357.

title: Reporting a Security Incident
content:
If you suspect a security incident:
IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:
1. Do NOT click any suspicious links or attachments
2. Disconnect from the network if malware is suspected (unplug ethernet, turn off Wi-Fi)
3. Do NOT attempt to clean the infection yourself

REPORTING:
1. Call IT Security immediately: ext. 4911 (Security Hotline)
2. Email: security@techcorp.com
3. Raise a CRITICAL priority ticket through IT Support

For phishing emails:
- Forward the email to phishing@techcorp.com
- Do not click any links in the email
- Delete the email after forwarding

All security incidents are treated with highest priority.

title: Setting Up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
content:
To set up MFA:
1. Download Microsoft Authenticator on your mobile device
2. Go to https://aka.ms/mfasetup from your work computer
3. Sign in with your corporate account
4. Click 'Add method' and select 'Authenticator app'
5. Scan the QR code shown on screen with the Microsoft Authenticator app
6. Enter the 6-digit code to verify setup

Alternative method (Phone call or SMS):
1. Select 'Phone' as the method
2. Enter your mobile number
3. Choose call or text verification

MFA is mandatory for all remote access including VPN, email, and cloud applications.
